notes.title: Major Update Alert! Dive into a Brand-New Journey in KONCOLOS
notes.content:
What's New:

New Storyline: We've prepared a special story update for you! Our team has been hard at work crafting a new tale for the world of Koncolos and its monster hunters. This fresh narrative aims to retell the adventurers of the monster hunters with a new perspective. We believe that this new story will take you to a more intimate and truly connectable world.

Character Design Revamp: We're thrilled to share our character design updates with you! Our team has given our characters a fresh new look. With these enhanced visuals, we hope their personalities will shine even brighter, and we're excited for their interactions to become even more enjoyable.

With gratitude...

notes.title: "Koncolos" is Out!
notes.content:
"Do you know a monster that dwells around here?" she asked. An ordinary barkeepers' journey, intertwined with the only survivor from a shrouded monster hunter company, started with this question.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1912490/Koncolos/

notes.title: Major Update 1.4: Aras
notes.content:
Changing the appearance of the protagonist may be an uncommon phenomenon. But the messy hair of Aras was giving him a "punk" look that was not intended, so we decided that "combing his hair" would be a good idea since we haven't released the main game yet. We decided to carry that change into Koncolos: Prologue as well.

We applied a new concept design for the photos in game, also made minor improvements to the appearance of other characters.

notes.title: Minor Update 1.32
notes.content:
Bug fix for game audio.
Minor text update.
Added in game mouse cursor image.

notes.title: Bottle Update 1.3
notes.content:
Many players criticized the fact that there were no bottles in Koncolos: Prologue visual novel. What a shame! With this update, we will now be able to witness the glory of bottles, and share our stories with them as well.

The update also includes minor changes to the way the texts are presented.

See you in the next update.

notes.title: New Narrative Update
notes.content: We've decided to make an effective improvement to the game's story, and we've been working on it for a while. Koncolos: Prologue texts were rewritten from the ground to strengthen the narrative. The story texts consist of more than 5000 words and 1/3 of them have been renewed. Aras' inner voices has been altered to support the story structure and it is more suitable for the finale of the main version of the game. Also we updated the inter-character dialogues to offer distinctive supporting characters.

notes.title: Minor Update
notes.content:
Fixed minor grammar errors 
Some graphical assets are polished

notes.title: New update: Achievements
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

I've released a new build of the game with achievement! There are now seven in-game achievements to collect to track your progress. You can get them as the adventure continues. 

Stay safe!
